name: snow-cabin
description: A tall snowy-cabin pane: snow falls softly on a white forest below snowy peaks, and a white rabbit, a white fox and a magpie come by. While Claude works night falls, the chimney smokes, the windows glow and snowmen appear one by one.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the labels and descriptions this mod shows: en (English) or ko (한국어)
